blocks.alt: When a thin metal wire is stretched, it becomes longer and thinner. This causes a change in the resistance of the wire. The volume of the wire remains constant. Which graph could represent the variation with extension x of the resistance R of the wire? R x 0 0 A R x 0 0 B R x 0 0 C R x 0 0 D
